mapper.select: SELECT invocation_id,attempt_id, (request_schema=#{requestSchema} AND request_json IS NOT NULL) AS request_recorded, (outcome_schema=#{outcomeSchema} AND outcome_json IS NOT NULL) IS TRUE AS outcome_recorded FROM public.nw_model_call_records WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (invocation_id,attempt_id) IN (#{key.invocationId},#{key.attemptId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_model_call_records(tenant_id,invocation_id,attempt_id,request_schema,request_json) SELECT tenant_id,invocation_id,attempt_id,#{schema},#{body} FROM public.nw_external_invocations WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invocation_id=#{invocation} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND operation_type='model.chat' ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,attempt_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nw_model_call_records SET outcome_schema=#{schema},outcome_json=#{body},outcome_recorded_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invocation_id=#{invocation} AND attempt_id=#{attempt} AND outcome_schema IS NULL
